_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley Dialogue-Willy.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Japanese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "japanese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, reading, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "japanese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).

AcceptGift_(O)336.japanese: （カリッ）…本物の金か。ハハハ！これはとんでもない贈り物だ！$h
AcceptGift_(O)336.english: *Crunch*... Real gold, huh? Hahaha! What an incredible gift!

AcceptGift_(O)682.japanese: うおっ！ …これはどういうモンスターなんだ？
AcceptGift_(O)682.english: Whoa! ...What kind of monster is this?

AcceptGift_(O)Book_Crabbing.japanese: ああ…不朽の名作だ。読むたびに涙が出る。漁師の必読書だ。何冊あっても困りはしない！ありがとよ。$h
AcceptGift_(O)Book_Crabbing.english: Ah... a timeless masterpiece. It brings tears every time I read it. Required reading for fishermen. It's no trouble having however many copies! Thanks.

AcceptGift_(O)Book_Roe.japanese: ありがとよ！冬に読むにはぴったりだ。それに、そいつからは海の香りもする…$h
AcceptGift_(O)Book_Roe.english: Thanks! This'll be perfect reading for winter. Plus, it smells of the sea too...

AcceptGift_(O)SkillBook_1.japanese: ああ、「エサとウキ」か…釣り人ならみんな毎号読んでいるはずだが、それなりの出費になる。長いことそいつから釣りのコツを教わってきたんだ。ありがとよ！$h
AcceptGift_(O)SkillBook_1.english: Ah, 'Bait And Bobber', huh... Every angler should read every issue, but it costs a fair amount. I've learned fishing tips from it for a long time. Thanks!

AcceptGift_(O)StardropTea.japanese: こいつは… スタードロップティーか！人魚伝説にだけ出てくるもんだと思ってたよ。ありがとよ！
AcceptGift_(O)StardropTea.english: This is... Stardrop Tea?! I thought it only appeared in mermaid legends. Thanks!

segments.text: スタードロップティー
segments.kana: スタードロップティー

AcceptGift_Positive_coffee_item.japanese: ああ、体にしみわたる。ありがとよ。
AcceptGift_Positive_coffee_item.english: Ah, this warms me up all over. Thanks.

Fair_Judged.japanese: おや、 低い点数 じゃねえか。 たぶん、 ルイス町長は あんまり 魚好きじゃない かもな…$s
Fair_Judged.english: Oh, that's a low score, isn't it. I guess Mayor Lewis isn't much of a fish lover, maybe...

Fair_Judging.japanese: これは 勝ち目が なさそうだな… 見た目は いいんだが、 匂いが きついぜ…$s
Fair_Judging.english: This doesn't look like it has much chance of winning... It looks good, but the smell is harsh...

Fri.japanese: 魚の 食いつきを 本当に 良くしたいなら、 釣り針に エサを つけておくんだな。
Fri.english: If you really want to improve the fish's bite rate, you should put bait on your hook.

Fri4.japanese: おれはぜいたく者じゃない… パイプにたばこ葉がつまっていればしあわせなんだ。パイプが空になったら… またつめるのさ。$u
Fri4.english: I'm not an extravagant man... I'm happy as long as my pipe is packed with tobacco leaf. Once my pipe's empty... I just fill it again.

FullCrabPond.japanese: （クンクン）...あぁ...あの古いおなじみの香りだ。レーズンのカニだよね？#$b#心の後ろにはあの${男^女}$、@。ハー！$h#$b#ここだよ、持って行って。それをビーチで見つけた...特別な日のために取っておくよ。毎日仲間のカニオタクを見つけるわけじゃないよ！[797]
FullCrabPond.english: *sniff*... Ah... that's an old familiar scent. That's raisin crab, isn't it? You're a ${man^woman}$ after my own heart, @. Ha! Here, take this. I found it on the beach... I was saving it for a special day. It's not every day I find a fellow crab enthusiast!

GreenRain.japanese: ああ…この変な雨で魚たちに悪影響がでなけりゃいいが…魚たちになにかあれば、おれの人生にかかわる！
GreenRain.english: Ah... I hope this strange rain doesn't have a bad effect on the fish... If something happens to the fish, it'll affect my whole life!

GreenRainFinished.japanese: どうやら魚たちに変わりはないようだ。よくエサに食いついてたからな！
GreenRainFinished.english: It seems the fish are unaffected after all. They were biting the bait really well!

GreenRain_2.japanese: 魚たちがこの雨を気に入っているなら、おれも同じだ。
GreenRain_2.english: If the fish like this rain, then I feel the same.

Introduction.japanese: やぁ！若いもんが 谷に やってくるとは いいことだ。めったに 起こるような もんじゃねえからな。
Introduction.english: Hey! It's a good thing that young folk are coming to the valley. It's not something that happens often.

Mon.japanese: よぉ、坊主。^よぉ、嬢ちゃん。#$b#今日は 釣り日和じゃねえか？
Mon.english: Yo, lad.^Yo, lass.#$b#Isn't today good fishing weather?

Mon4.japanese: この辺で いいものは つれたか？コツを つかんで 本気で やれば、 あんたは 優れた 釣り人に なれそうだな。
Mon4.english: Have you caught anything good around here? If you get the knack of it and put your mind to it, you seem like you could become an excellent angler.

MovieInvitation.japanese: ああ… 映画か。そいつはいいね、坊主。^ああ… 映画か。そいつはいいね、嬢ちゃん。#$b#パイプを吸い終わったら、すぐに行くよ。
MovieInvitation.english: Ah... a movie, huh. That sounds nice, lad.^Ah... a movie, huh. That sounds nice, lass.#$b#Once I finish my pipe, I'll head right over.

Sat.japanese: もし 地元の 釣り場が もっと 活発になれば、 店の 品揃えも 充実 させられるんだがな。
Sat.english: If the local fishing spot became livelier, I could enrich the shop's stock, I suppose.

Sat8.japanese: 最近の 釣りの 調子は どうだ？#$e#オレも できるだけ 釣りを しようとは してるが、 店を やってるから そう 簡単には いかんな。
Sat8.english: How's fishing been lately?#$e#I try to fish as much as I can too, but running a shop means it's not that easy.

Sun.japanese: 高品質な 釣竿を 買えば、 釣りエサと 釣具を つけられるようになるぞ。#$b#釣りエサは 魚が 早く 針に 食いつくようになる。釣具は 魚を 簡単に 引き上げられるように なるぞ。#$e#釣具によって、 異なる 効果を 持っているが、大体の 釣具は もろいから、 使っている間に 壊れても 驚くんじゃ ねえぞ。
Sun.english: If you buy a high-quality fishing rod, you'll be able to attach fishing bait and tackle to it.#$b#Fishing bait makes fish bite the hook faster. Tackle makes it easier to reel fish in.#$e#Tackle has different effects depending on the type, but most tackle is fragile, so don't be surprised if it breaks while you're using it.

segments.kana: つかっているあいだに

Sun10.japanese: よお、@船長じゃないか！$h#$e#余裕が あったら、 釣りエサの 割引でも してやれたんだがな。$s
Sun10.english: Hey, it's Captain @, isn't it!#$e#If I had some extra money, I could've given you a discount on fishing bait.

Thu.japanese: ぶつぶつ…ん？オレが 何を 考えていたかって？ 教えたいが、 漁師の 秘密さ。
Thu.english: *mumble mumble*... Hm? You're asking what I was thinking? I'd like to tell you, but it's a fisherman's secret.

Thu2.japanese: この辺には とても 珍しい魚が いるって ウワサだが… 熟練の 釣り人じゃなければ 勝負に ならない らしいぞ。#$e#珍しい 魚を 釣りたいなら、 最高級の エサを 用意するんだな。
Thu2.english: There's a rumor that there's a very rare fish around here... but apparently only a skilled angler stands a chance.#$e#If you want to catch the rare fish, you should prepare the finest bait.

Tue.japanese: 本物の 釣り人は 釣り場に 敬意を 払うんだ… 忘れんなよ。
Tue.english: A true angler pays respect to the fishing spot... don't forget that.

Tue6.japanese: オレも 昔は 釣りをやってたんだ。フェーン諸島へ 船を 出し、 毎日 魚を 捕って 育った。#$e#釣り人の 生活は 簡単じゃねえが、 続けさせてくれる 何かが そこに あるんだよ。
Tue6.english: I used to fish, too, back in the day. I set sail for the Fern Islands and grew up catching fish every day.#$e#An angler's life isn't easy, but there's something there that keeps you going.

Wed.japanese: 季節によって 場所を 変える 魚がいる。一部の魚は、 夜間か 雨の時にしか 釣れないぞ。
Wed.english: Some fish change their location depending on the season. Some fish can only be caught at night or when it's raining.

Wed6.japanese: 滝の間にある淵には、変わった魚が一匹いると聞いたことがある…#$b#おまえさんの釣竿が届けばの話だが…
Wed6.english: I've heard there's an unusual fish in the pool between the waterfalls...#$b#That is, if your fishing rod can reach it...

accept_869.japanese: ああ…私が狙っていたナマズにぴったりなエサだな！#$b#これと交換してくれないか。これが何なのかはわからないが、少し前に浜辺に流れ着いていたんだ。#$b#お前さんなら使えそうな気がするんだよ、坊主。^お前さんなら使えそうな気がするんだよ、嬢ちゃん。
accept_869.english: Ah... that's the perfect bait for the catfish I've been after!#$b#Won't you trade this for it? I don't know what this is, but it washed up on the beach a while ago.#$b#I have a feeling you could use it, lad.^I have a feeling you could use it, lass.

segments.kana: こうかんしてくれない

fishCaught_159.japanese: クリムゾンフィッシュを釣ったのか！あの魚には何年も困ってたんだ。おれの家の土台の木をかじろうとするんだ！
fishCaught_159.english: You caught the Crimsonfish?! That fish has been troubling me for many years. It keeps trying to gnaw at the wood under my house's foundation!

segments.text: クリムゾンフィッシュ
segments.kana: クリムゾンフィッシュ

fishCaught_160.japanese: ああ、ツリビトアンコウを釣ったのか？希少な魚の世界にふみだす第一歩としては上出来だ。
fishCaught_160.english: Ah, you caught the Angler? As a first step into the world of rare fish, that's well done.

fishCaught_163.japanese: そうか…おまえさん、本当に「レジェンド」を釣り上げたんだな。まさかこんな日が来るとは…$h#$b#坊主、よくやったな…おまえさんはこの谷はじまって一番の漁師だ…$h^嬢ちゃん、よくやったな…おまえさんはこの谷はじまって一番の漁師だ…$h
fishCaught_163.english: I see... you really caught "the Legend," huh. I can't believe such a day would come...#$b#Lad, well done... you're the best fisherman this valley's ever seen...^Lass, well done... you're the best fisherman this valley's ever seen...

fishCaught_682.japanese: （クンクン）…下水道で釣りをしていたようだな、坊主。^（クンクン）…下水道で釣りをしていたようだな、嬢ちゃん。#$b#よくそんな型破りなことを思いついたもんだ。あそこにはな、有毒なヘドロで怪物に変わった巨大なコイの伝説があるんだ…
fishCaught_682.english: *sniff sniff*... Seems like you've been fishing in the sewers, lad.^*sniff sniff*... Seems like you've been fishing in the sewers, lass.#$b#That's quite an unconventional idea you came up with. There's a legend of a giant carp that transformed into a monster from toxic sludge over there...

fishCaught_775.japanese: ああ、ついにアイスフィッシュを釣り上げたのか…おれも挑んだが、とんでもなくすべりやすい魚だ！#$e#どのくらい挑戦したんだ？
fishCaught_775.english: Ah, you finally caught the Glacierfish... I tried too, but that's an incredibly slippery fish!#$e#How many times did you try?

married.japanese: 独身生活に見切りをつけたのか？#$b#だが、釣りはやめるんじゃないぞ…
married.english: Did you give up on the single life?#$b#But don't give up fishing...

summer_19.japanese: 明日は恒例のマス釣り大会だ…淡水釣り好きには夢みたいなイベントだ！#$e#世界中の釣り人が美しいニジマスを釣りにやってくる…#$e#会えるのを楽しみにしてるぞ、坊主！$h^興味があれば来るといい！$h#$e#これから2日間は、朝9時から1時間だけ店を開けるからな。必要なものがあればその間に来てくれ。
summer_19.english: Tomorrow's the annual Trout Derby... it's a dream event for freshwater fishing lovers!#$e#Anglers from all over the world come to fish for the beautiful Rainbow Trout...#$e#I'm looking forward to seeing you there, lad!^Come along if you're interested!#$e#For the next two days, I'll only open the shop for one hour starting at 9am. Come by then if you need anything.

summer_20.japanese: ついに今日だな！釣り具をぜんぶマス釣り用に調整したんだ…#$e#おまえさんもがんばれよ！
summer_20.english: It's finally today! I've adjusted all my tackle for trout fishing...#$e#You do your best too!

summer_21.japanese: 釣り大会の調子はどうだ？#$b#おれはかなりの数の金色のタグを見つけたが… まだまだ終わりじゃない！
summer_21.english: How's the fishing derby going?#$b#I've found quite a number of golden tags, but... it's far from over!

winter_11.japanese: 明日はビーチでちょっとしたイベントがある… 「イカ釣りまつり」だ。#$e#イカは手ごわい相手だ。とはいえ、おまえさんはもう釣りのコツをつかんでいるはずだ。 そうだろう？
winter_11.english: Tomorrow there's a little event at the beach... It's the "Squid Fest."#$e#Squid are a formidable opponent. That said, you should have gotten the hang of fishing by now. Right?

winter_12.japanese: まだあきらめるな！この海にはもっとイカがいるはずだ…
winter_12.english: Don't give up yet! There should be more squid in this sea...

winter_13.japanese: ここに集まった釣り人たちを見ると、冬のこごえた心も温かくなる。 みんな釣りを愛しているのがわかるからな…$h
winter_13.english: Seeing the anglers gathered here warms even my frozen winter heart. I can tell everyone loves fishing...
